about: Lists that cover all of Utah, shared by every office in or near Utah (Elder Bendio, 13 October 2026: share state and federal lists between Scout runs). Moved by Claude from the office files where list seeding first found them; byOffice keeps each office's own notes and name counts. A page with a section per county counts as statewide: an office reads its own county's section.
